# v0.4.1 — production hardening

Multi-worker, deployable, and merchant-onboardable. Full changelog:
[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/cyberd4ch/txn-agent/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Highlights

**Cross-worker approvals.** Approvals and runs persist to the SQLite store, so a
decision made by one worker (or the `/ops` console) resolves a run parked on
another. Runs record their owning worker (`owner_pid`, with in-place `_migrate()`
for existing databases); a restart that kills the owner surfaces the run as
`interrupted` — never silently resumed (fail closed).

**Multi-tenant env config.** `tenants_from_env()` builds the tenant registry from
`TXN_TENANTS` JSON (per-tenant API key, budget ceiling, store path, Stripe payment
methods, approval timeout) for multi-worker deploys behind one service.

**Deploy guide.** [docs/deploy.md](docs/deploy.md): uvicorn workers, `TXN_TENANTS`,
TLS via Caddy, Stripe test/live setup, backups, a systemd unit, and a post-deploy
smoke check.

**Merchant reference adapter.** [`examples/distributor_service.py`](../examples/distributor_service.py):
the merchant side of the [connector contract](../docs/connector-contract.md) as a
runnable FastAPI app (bearer auth, idempotent orders, decimal-string money) — a
distributor becomes agent-purchasable in an afternoon. See the
[distributor one-pager](../docs/distributor-pitch.md).

**First live Stripe test charge, scripted.** [`examples/stripe_charge.py`](../examples/stripe_charge.py):
gate → PaymentIntent for the exact total → merchant order → read the intent back
and verify amount/status. Refuses non-test keys. Plus `StripeVault.retrieve()`
for verification/reconciliation.

**Quality.** pytest-cov with an 85% floor and Codecov upload (CI + coverage badges);
fixed `StripeVault._request` sending bodyless POSTs (voids) as GET.

**62 tests · 87% coverage · ruff + mypy strict clean**
